categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Huiyun Titanium Industry Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of titanium dioxide products, including rutile and anatase titanium dioxide powders, along with related by-products such as sulfuric acid, steam, and iron concentrate. The company operates a sulfuric acid production line and focuses on high-quality titanium dioxide products for various industrial applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes the sulfate process for titanium dioxide production, a widely adopted method in China, enabling the manufacture of both anatase and rutile forms. It has developed proprietary technologies and holds multiple patents related to equipment and process improvements, including continuous acid digestion reactors, titanium dioxide superfine powder preparation, and energy-efficient MVR titanium liquid concentration technology. The company emphasizes clean production and circular economy principles, integrating sulfur, titanium, iron, and calcium cycles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span industries such as plastics, coatings, rubber, chemical fibers, ceramics, food, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, construction materials, photovoltaics, electronics, microelectromechanical systems, automotive, new energy, environmental protection, and catalysis. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant portion of sales in China and exports accounting for nearly 30% of titanium dioxide sales revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, headquartered in Yunfu City, Guangdong Province, with subsidiaries and production facilities in the region. It also has mining operations in Xinjiang and engages in international trade, exporting titanium dioxide products globally. The company leverages its location advantages in Guangdong for logistics and raw material supply.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Huiyun Titanium Industry Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream segment of the titanium dioxide supply chain, focusing on processing titanium concentrates into titanium dioxide pigment and related chemical products. It also extends upstream into mining through its subsidiary's exploration and mining rights and downstream by developing customized products and expanding applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation, capacity expansion, quality improvement, cost reduction, safety, and environmental protection. It invests heavily in R&D, focusing on new product development such as high-purity superfine titanium dioxide powders, surface-modified products, and energy-efficient production technologies. The company also emphasizes digital transformation and intelligent manufacturing to enhance operational efficiency and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of titanium dioxide products (rutile and anatase types), sulfuric acid, and related by-products. The company employs a combination of direct sales to end-users and distribution through authorized dealers. It also benefits from government subsidies and engages in financial activities such as convertible bond issuance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a mid-to-upper tier position in the domestic titanium dioxide industry, with competitive product quality and significant market share in mid-to-high-end applications. It faces competition from large-scale domestic and international titanium dioxide producers, especially amid increasing industry consolidation and price volatility. The company leverages its technological advantages, circular economy model, and brand reputation to maintain competitiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.66 billion, a slight increase of 0.5% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders declining by 89.23% due to intensified market competition and increased depreciation and financing costs. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.79 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.35 billion. It is undergoing capacity expansion and technological upgrades, with a focus on long-term sustainable growth despite short-term profit pressure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, including uniform particle size distribution, high whiteness, blue phase presence, high brightness, purity, opacity, dispersibility, and stability. It implements a 'boutique strategy' and personalized customized production to meet diverse customer needs. Its clean production process and circular economy model provide environmental benefits and cost advantages, while its strong R&D capabilities and patented technologies support continuous product innovation and differentiation.
